title: Planted-error recall for fidelity auditing: Haiku high, Sonnet high and Opus xhigh on audit and support tasks over seeded pages

document.name: nlogn
document.title: Integer multiplication below n log n (paper.tex)

task: fidelity auditing: 24 audit tasks (6 clean and 18 seeded page variants) and 20 support tasks per configuration-run, on 6 pages of the W1/W2 wikis with 36 planted errors and 18 shams
question: Which model and effort catch planted errors in the audit and support tasks, at what false-alarm rate, within what those tasks can see?

limitations: One run per configuration; six pages of one paper; 28 page-detectable and 10 quote-detectable errors per run.
The audit and support tasks do not compare a page with the paper, so source-only errors are out of reach by design.
The hand labels are one labeller's (this session's), made blind to configuration but after seeing the pooled preliminary scores.
